directions.name: 2 Tout ce qui n'etait pas elle

prompts.rough: A squat, heavy grey-brown boulder mass, wider than tall. On its front face three perfectly cut, sharp-edged stone steps rise into the rock and lead nowhere, a crisp straight line separating the smooth cut stone from the rough raw rock. A small hoist of three lashed wooden poles with a rope and pulley stands against the rock. A small heap of stone chips lies at its foot on a wooden sledge, a wooden mallet beside it. One apprentice in a plain tunic pulls the rope with both hands, back flat. Warm matte stone, matte ochre-red layout line, no shine, no gems, no crystals, no hanging cloth, no letters. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab, no painted cast shadow.
prompts.grand: A big block of warm grey-brown rock, taller than wide, with a great round-topped arch cut clean through it from side to side so the sky shows through. A straight stone ramp runs along its left face. The left half is smooth cut stone laid in six wide flat terraces, the right half stays rough, raw, heavier and taller rock overhanging the cut line, which is crisp and straight like a ruled line. A small wheel of solid planks, no spokes, sits on top on an offset oak crane arm. One worker climbs the outside of the wheel. Matte stone, matte ochre-red layout lines, no shine, no gems, no hanging cloth, no letters, not a pyramid, not a tower with a roof. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab, no painted cast shadow.
prompts.mythic: One single enormous natural rock rising tall, carved from the top down, no joints, no mortar. Its left half is a tower of smooth stone with wide terraced steps and two storeys of arches, no roof, no battlements, no windows like a lookout. Its right half is a heavier, taller raw cliff of rough broken rock in shadow, overhanging the cut line. The line between smooth and raw climbs diagonally and is crisp, and the very top is still raw rock with a small plank wheel on an offset crane arm. One big chunk of rock slides down the raw face toward a heap at the foot. Small matte ochre-red tailor marks on the steps. One worker pulls a rope at the foot with both hands. Not a pyramid, not a wizard tower, not a watchtower, not a black silhouette. Matte warm stone, no shine, no gems, no crystals, no hanging cloth, no letters. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab, no painted cast shadow.

prompts.rough: A low cut into a grassy mound with a small hoist of three lashed wooden poles and a rope. In front, a knee-high dry-stone wall of mismatched stones, crooked, with one clearly visible square gap in it. A single round pebble-shaped rock hangs from the hoist rope, plainly the wrong shape for the square gap. A woman mason with feet planted hoists the rope with both hands, back flat. Matte grey-brown stone, a small lantern on the hoist, no shine, no hanging cloth, no letters. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab, no painted cast shadow.
prompts.grand: A tall mass of wall, taller than wide, made of about twelve large unequal grey-brown stones with sharp angles, each stone biting into its neighbour with no gaps, no mortar. The crest is jagged and irregular, no battlements, no crenellation, no round low wall. An oak crane with an offset arm, pulleys and straps stands beside it. A woman mason lifts a stone off the ground by a strap, back flat and knees bent. A small low lodge window at the foot, a lantern on the crane. Matte stone, no shine, no hanging cloth, no letters, no beam, no gallows. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab, no painted cast shadow.
prompts.mythic: A cliff-like wall of six or seven giant grey-brown stones, each larger than a house, with sharp angles that bite into each other without any gap or mortar, one stone in the middle with twelve sharp angles. The crest is irregular and jagged, no battlements, no crenellation, no round low wall, no timber beam, no gallows, no trebuchet. At the top is one clear five-sided notch, empty. Just above it, a house-sized stone of the same five-sided shape, held by thick ropes to a stout crane mast standing behind the wall, with one clear open gap of air between the stone and the notch. A thick rope runs down to a woman mason at the foot, feet planted on the ground, pulling with both hands. A thin trickle of stone grains falls from one joint. Matte stone, no shine, no hanging cloth, no letters, no mist. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab, no painted cast shadow.
